# A Deeper Darker Train - Mobs & New Dimension

![A Deeper Darker Train - Mobs & New Dimension](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/a-deeper-darker-train.jpg)

Deep down the line, past the stranger stretches you already know, the ride now drops into somewhere darker than anything before it.

**A new stretch of the journey.** Its own scenery, its own ruins to find, its own sea and its own sky. The track, the tunnels and the carriages all dress for it, and the way the mountains lead you in is one long unbroken climb from the stretch before.

**New creatures ride the train.** Some carriages deep down carry what lives there, and the stretch itself is home to them too. They are not from around here.

**Bug Fix ×4 · Performance ×4 · Compatibility ×3 · New Feature ×2 · Community ×1 · Balance ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1425.0

**Block info spoiler fix**

A block-info mod could give away a hidden surprise in some walls. In survival it now tells you only what you would see with your own eyes.

### 0.1424.0

**No freeze when you earn an advancement**

Earning an advancement could freeze the game for several seconds on some computers, because it waited on the disk before carrying on. The save now happens in the background, so the game keeps running while it writes.

- Earning an advancement no longer waits on the disk
- Leaving a server no longer holds up the other players while your advancements save

### 0.1423.0

**Smoother ticks and quieter logs**

The game's performance notes are now written in the background instead of making the world wait for the log file, and sitting in the pause menu no longer fills your log with false freeze reports.

### 0.1420.0

**Safer with mod updates**

If one of the bundled mods updates ahead of the pack, its portals keep working and the game still starts.

**Not every pot is quite what it seems**

Break them carefully.

### 0.1419.0

**Dev launch improvement**

Launching a dev client straight into a world that no longer exists now stops with a clear message listing the worlds that do, instead of a failed load.

**Lighter ride through the stranger stretches**

The stranger stretches of the line now cost the server less work every tick, so the ride stays smooth with more mobs and items about. Nothing looks or behaves differently.

**Shorter autosave pause**

The game paused for a second or more every time it autosaved, because the train was being written to disk the slow way. Autosaves now write the train the same way the rest of the world is written, so the pause is much shorter. Saving on quit is unchanged.

- Autosaves and the pause save no longer wait on the disk for every train file
- Quitting the world still saves everything fully before it closes

### 0.1417.0

**Quieter passenger log announcements**

The public passenger log's milestone and first-ever announcements no longer end with your carriage and difficulty. Where you are on the train stays yours to share.

### 0.1416.0

**Heavy armor keeps helping**

Stacking armor and armor toughness now keeps paying off. Armor used to stop helping once it blocked 80% of a hit; now heavier armor and tougher gear keep blocking a little more, slowly climbing toward a ceiling just under 90%. Very heavily armored mobs deep in the run get a little tougher too.

- Armor past the old limit now blocks more damage, never reaching 90%
- Armor toughness keeps helping once your armor is maxed out
1.21.1.0.1417.0:
**New Feature ×2 · Performance ×2 · Bug Fix ×1 · Compatibility ×1 · World ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1416.0

**Lighter carriage checks**

Looking up a carriage's blocks now costs the same however big the carriage is, so the wind and other checks around the train stay cheap on long and wide carriages.

**Quieter logs**

The game log no longer fills with the same few lines repeated thousands of times. Bug reports now carry the part that matters, and the game spends less time writing to disk while you play.

### 0.1414.0

**Rain leans with the wind under shader packs**

Deep down the line the train wind already tilts the rain. With a shader pack on, the rain was too faint and too busy with the pack's own sway for that lean to show. It now reads there too: the rain leans harder and falls thicker while the wind blows, so you can see which way it is coming from. Without shaders nothing changes.

- Rain visibly leans with the wind under shader packs
- No change to the rain without shaders

**Some places pull you in**

Deep down the line, some of the stranger places have a pull of their own. Step off the train near one and you drift toward it, land on it, and can jump free again. Whatever you throw or shoot curves in too, and the wind dies away there.

- Riders out on the roof feel a gentle tug. Inside a carriage you feel nothing.
- Strength, reach and how the pull lets go are all in the config.

# The train gets cold, and the wind blows the weather

![The train gets cold, and the wind blows the weather](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/the-train-gets-cold-and-the-wind-blows-the-weather.jpg)

Deep down the line, the ride is getting harsher in two ways.

**The train gets cold.** Some stretches turn bitterly cold. Out on the roof, a flatbed or a coupling pad, frost creeps over you, just as it does in powder snow. Only a carriage closed in on every side keeps you warm, so step inside to thaw. It starts slow and bites faster the further you have travelled, never quite reaching the cold of powder snow. Leather armour slows the frost: every piece doubles the time you can stay out before it bites.

**The wind blows the weather.** Where the train's wind blows, the weather feels it too. Rain leans into each gust and swings back as it passes, snow is swept sideways and flies at you when you face into it, and campfire smoke, petals and ash beside the track drift away downwind. Inside a carriage or under cover the air stays still.

*The train continues to get harder. Feedback on the balance is welcome.*

**World ×2 · New Feature ×1 · Performance ×1**

### 0.1411.0

**The wind follows you off the train**

The wind no longer stops at the edge of the train. Step down onto the ground and it keeps shoving you about just the same. Walls, tunnels and the train itself still give you shelter when you stand behind them, and it leaves you alone in the water.

- Jump off the train and the wind comes with you.
- Duck behind a wall, or behind the train, and it drops away.

### 0.1410.0

**Lighter End islands generation**

The End islands crossings now generate each chunk with less work and far less memory churn: the terrain copy no longer builds a wide ring of empty scratch chunks, asks the biome layout once per column instead of once per block row, and skips a cave pass that never carved anything. What you see on the islands is unchanged.

- End islands chunks generate with about a fifth less processing and a quarter of the memory churn
- No change to how the islands look
1.21.1.0.1408.0:
# The Deep Train gets Windy

![The Deep Train gets Windy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/the-deep-train-gets-windy.jpg)

Deep down the line, for the most brave, skilled and committed adventurers, lies a new challenge.

The carts might be full of buffed up monsters, but now the roof of the train, and anywhere the walls don't protect you, face gusts of wind! The taller places feel it more, and underground is safe from it. Forever growing stronger. The train continues to get harder.

Special thanks to Lil Detective Crunch for the idea.

*I will be taking feedback on the wind balancing, and I will be rebalancing monsters later too.*

# Donation rewards, now in game

![Donation rewards, now in game](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/donation-rewards-in-game.png)

The thank-you that comes with a gift to the dev is now something you can use in Dungeon Train.

**Book Boosts.** Every $10 you give carries 10 Book Boosts. Found a book you loved? Turn to its last page and tap the star to boost it, as many times as you like. Each boost on someone else's book costs 1, and the author is told which donors boosted it. Want your own writing seen? Boost it when you sign it, or tap the star on your own copy later, for 10. The star beside the book shows how many boosts you have left.

Also, a **Copy Book button**, for the donors who are making an archive of every book they've read.

Rewards are matched to your Minecraft account, so they need network features switched on.

## Other significant updates

- New cargo: crates, trees and a TNT boxcar
- Many new woods down the line, and new enemy rooms
- Quicker Streams: when it's on, the Live Eye reaches viewers in seconds
- Community photos hang in the carriages' picture frames
- Website watchers wear their own skin, and the Live page names viewers wearing a TV
- Mobs stay put: they no longer die to passing carriages, slide to the back, or vanish when they step off
- See what each advancement unlocks
- Distant Horizons fits in better, and Bobby is an approved mod
- Lighter terrain generation and many bug fixes

**New Feature ×2 · Menus & UI ×2 · Community ×1 · Books ×1**

### 0.1405.0

**Updates have names**

When a new version comes out while you're playing, the chat message now tells you what the update is called, not just its number. Big updates stand out with a banner, a short description and a sound.

### 0.1401.0

**Boost other players' books**

Book Boosts from donating can now go on anyone's book, not just your own. Tap the star on a book's last page to help it reach more players, as many times as you like.

- Each Priority Book is now 10 Book Boosts. Boosting someone else's book uses 1, boosting your own uses 10.
- Your boosts left sit beside the book, and authors are told which donors boosted their writing.

# Community Rewards

![Community Rewards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/community-rewards.jpg)

Rewards the whole community benefits from. There are features I'd love to provide, but they cost more than I can take on alone. Now one person can unlock them for everyone! Give a Community Reward and everyone gets it, not just the donor.

The first reward is **Quicker Streams**: cover the server costs and the Live Eye stream delay drops from 30s to 6s for a whole month, for everyone. More rewards are on the way.

## Other significant updates
- Support the solo-dev now opens one Contribute screen, the same one the engine room shows, from the title screen, the pause menu and Credits
- A new rewards page: Community Rewards for everyone, and Personal Rewards showing what each gift to the dev brings you
- Every gift puts your name aboard, and gifts to the dev also bring Priority Books
- Copying the books you read is now a thank-you for gifts of $30 or more

**New Feature ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1404.0

**Gift amounts in your own currency**

The Contribute screens now have a currency button at the top right. Pick your currency and every gift shows roughly what it comes to in your money. Gifts are still made in Australian dollars. Your choice is remembered, and the game starts from the currency that matches your language.

- 13 currencies to choose from, each with its own flag
- A currency picker on the website's support page too

# Smarter mob buffs

![Smarter mob buffs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/smarter-mob-buffs.jpg)

Deep train potion buffs on train mobs have been reworked. The later stages of the game are more balanced. Rather than a flat potion effect for every mob, the effect is now a max, and they will get a random level between 1 and the current stage max. Additionally, mobs that turn up later get potion effects delayed (and babies get effects a little later too).

- **More variety:** the further you ride, the wider the spread. A buffed mob now rolls anywhere from level I up to that stretch's top level, so some are weaker than before and none are stronger.
- **Late arrivals catch up gradually:** mobs that only start showing up further down the train no longer get buffed the moment they appear. Their buffs begin later, counted from where they first show up.
- **Babies get a head start for you:** baby mobs get their buffs a little later than adults.

**Bug Fix ×2 · Mobs ×2 · Train ×1**

### 0.1399.0

**Mobs no longer get stuck in the train floor**

Mobs could appear standing inside a carriage floor, with their heads poking up through the deck as the train carried them along. An Enderman stuck there could even be angered by a glance from inside the carriage. Mobs no longer appear there, and any already stuck are moved out to the ground beside the train.

### 0.1398.0

**Mobs stay put in moving carriages**

Animals, villagers and monsters standing inside a carriage no longer slowly slide toward the back of the train. The further you travelled, the faster they slid, up to several blocks a minute on long runs. Now they stay where they stand.

**The Live Eye no longer sits on a black box while its video tools download**

Putting the Live Eye on before the video tools have finished downloading used to leave a blank dark box on screen with no way out. The box now says what it is waiting for, and if the download goes nowhere for a minute and a half the broadcast calls it off, tells you why, and hands the Live Eye back so you can try again once the TVs are playing.

- The pinned box says it is getting the video tools, with a percentage when one is known
- A download that stalls hands the Live Eye back instead of waiting forever

### 0.1335.0

**Empty chests no longer count**

A challenge about opening chests now only counts chests that have loot in them. Opening an empty one no longer moves you closer.

### 0.1333.0

**Less lag in the Nether**

Thousands of dropped vines were piling up as the land loaded in and slowing the game. They no longer drop.

### 0.1332.0

**Dimensional carriage visual fix**

Fixed a visual glitch in some dimensional carriages.

### 0.1331.0

**Enchantment tidy-up**

Tidied up the enchantment pool.

### 0.1330.0

**Advancement fix**

Advancement fix.

### 0.1329.0

**Nether portal fix**

Fixed a case where a Nether portal could leave you stranded.

### 0.1328.0

**Dimensional carriages stay linked after a save**

Dimensional carriages further up a long train could stop working after the game autosaved, leaving the corridor to end at a black wall. They now always open onto their room.

### 0.1327.0

**Dimensional carriages have coordinates of their own**

Inside a dimensional carriage, the debug screen (F3) now puts the middle of the room at X 0, Z 0, so it reads as a place of its own rather than a spot along the track.

- The middle of a dimensional carriage reads X 0, Z 0 on F3
- Looking at a block in one shows the same disguised coordinates

### 0.1326.0

**Two new death pages for lives you streamed**

If you wore the Live Eye at any point in a life, the death screen now tells the story of that broadcast: how long you were on air, what you shared, who took the Eye, and who stayed with you the most.

- The broadcast: your time on air across the whole life, moments and photos shared, how many times you went live, and how far behind your viewers were.
- The crowd: the viewer who was with you most, by watching and chatting, shown in their own skin, plus your peak audience, chat lines and votes won.
- Your death clip, and whoever picked up the Eye after you.
- The mod recommendations page no longer appears after a death.

**The photo page counts your photos**

The photo page on the death screen now tallies the life you just lived: how many photos you took, how many of other players' photos you looked at, how many Tributes you paid and the emeralds they cost. The page now appears whenever there is something to count, even with no photos to show.

### 0.1325.0

**Link codes stay off your stream**

When you link your Discord or Twitch while wearing the Live Eye, your viewers no longer see the code. Chat is briefly hidden from the stream while the code is on your screen, so nobody watching can use it before you do.

**A gifted Live Eye no longer leaves nobody live**

When you gift your Live Eye to a viewer, you now keep streaming until they actually go live. If they can't stream after all, or they leave, your stream carries on. Gifts are also only offered to viewers who can stream, so players in Free Play are no longer offered one.

**Creaking hearts wake by day**

Creaking hearts no longer sleep through the day. Pale Gardens now send out their Creakings at any hour, so a sunny stop is no safer than a night one.

**Pay Tributes from your backpack**

Emeralds and emerald blocks in your backpack slots now count when paying a Tribute, so you no longer have to move them into your inventory first.

1.21.1.0.1318.0:
# New Mobs

![New Mobs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/new-mobs.jpg)

New creatures have boarded the train. The first of many more to come.

Some carriages now hold mobs you’ve never met on the line before. A few turn up early, and some wait much further down the line, in the stranger stretches of the journey. Keep your eyes open and your sword ready.

## Other significant updates

- Your Live stream shares your advancements, photos and books in Live chat on Discord, Twitch and the website, with a switch for each on the Stream tab
- One Live Eye per player, and /streamer in Live chat shows who's on air
- Builders: test controls let you try a build at any stage, difficulty level or band, and Test the Carriage can bring your frozen mobs to life
- Builders: block variants can depend on their neighbours, and a dice button swaps the carriage around your contents
- Bug fixes

**New Feature ×8 · Editor ×7 · Bug Fix ×3 · Community ×3 · Train ×1 · Loot ×1 · Menus & UI ×1**

### 0.1318.0

**Test controls in the editor**

While you test a build from the editor, the template pane now gives you controls for the test itself. Try your build at any stage, difficulty level or band, and re-roll just your build or everything around it, all without changing the template.

- A test toolbar above the preview: Reload, Re-roll the rest, Re-roll this template and Re-roll everything
- Stage, Diff level and Band settings replace the data sheet while a test runs, and changing one re-stands the test on the same rolls
- Reload picks up templates you saved since the test started

**Back from a test returns you to the room you tested**

Leaving Test the Carriage now puts you back in the room you were testing, even when you started the test from another plot. Rooms inside a group come back with their group open, so you can carry straight on editing.

### 0.1317.0

**Reroll the carriage around your contents**

When you build carriage contents in the Train Editor, a new dice button above the preview swaps the carriage they stand in for another one that carries them on the train. Your unsaved changes stay put.

- New Reroll carriage button in the Train Editor's icon row for contents
- Only picks carriages that would really carry those contents, never the one already shown

**Block variants can depend on their neighbours**

In the editor, a block variant option can now say when it is allowed to appear: only next to certain blocks, or only when another locked group rolled certain blocks. Torches only on walls, glass only above planks, and matching sets that follow each other are now easy to build.

- New If button on each block variant option, with a choice of touching sides or a locked group
- Pick the sides with the same clicks as choosing bands: click to toggle one, shift-click to toggle the rest
- Add the blocks to look for from your hand, or switch on blocks from the chosen group

### 0.1316.0

**Taking over a Live Eye stream waits until you've seen the death**

When a Live Eye streamer dies, viewers are now offered the stream only after their TV has shown the death, instead of getting the offer before it happened on screen.

### 0.1315.0

**Block variant groups stay alive while a variant refers to them**

A group you add as an option in a block variant now keeps existing even after every cell of that group is gone from the template, so the option keeps working instead of going dead.

- A group added as a block variant option keeps its options after its last cell is removed or unlocked
- Middle-click a group row in the block variant menu to put that group in your hotbar
- Adding a group you copied from another template works even if this template has no cells in it

**Ask who's streaming**

Type /streamer in the Live chat, in game, on the website, on Discord or on Twitch, to see who's on air: their Minecraft, Twitch and Discord names, how long they've been live, how many times they've streamed before and their game language. Everyone in the chat sees the answer.

### 0.1314.0

**One Live Eye per player**

You can now carry only one Live Eye at a time, and that includes any in your ender chest or packed in a shulker box. Once you have one, chests show a TV where a Live Eye would be, a second one on the ground stays put for someone else, and any extra that slips into your inventory turns into a TV.

### 0.1313.0

**Unsupported plants no longer leave loot behind**

Moss, vines and other plants that need something to cling to used to pop off and drop an item when a carriage was built without a spot for them. They now quietly vanish instead, so there are no stray freebies lying on carriage floors or in the builder.

### 0.1312.0

**Your Live stream shares your advancements, photos and books**

While you stream with the Live Eye, the Live chat on Discord, Twitch and the website now shows when you earn an advancement, take a photo or sign a book. Photos show as the picture itself, on its paper, and books show their title and first lines. Nothing extra appears in your own game chat.

- Turn each one off on the Stream tab: Share advancements, Share photos, Share books
- Always off in Kid mode

**Test the Carriage can bring your mobs to life**

A new editor setting lets your frozen mobs wake up when you test a carriage, so you can see how a room plays with its creatures moving. Your build plots keep them still.

- New Test Mobs setting in the editor
- Works for every kind of template you can test
1.21.1.0.1311.0:

### 0.1311.0

**Dimensional carriage chests roll their own loot**

Chests built into a dimensional carriage now fill from the loot their builder set up, so each one you find can hold something different instead of the same items every time. In the editor, Reseed on Test the Carriage now re-rolls those chests too.

- Builders: Reseed (Cmd/Ctrl+R) shows a fresh roll of every chest that has a loot list

**Pick your difficulty for the next run, or restart on it now**

Changing difficulty mid-run now asks what you want: keep this run going and start the next one on the new difficulty, or abandon this run and board a fresh train on it straight away. Dungeon Train remembers your choice for every new world, and the Options menu has a Difficulty setting of its own.

- Save a difficulty change for your next run, or restart on it now.
- Your chosen difficulty carries over to every new world.
- Advancement stats are now kept for each difficulty.

**Something for the road**

Some travellers may find the train has left them a small kindness.

1.21.1.0.1310.0:
**New Feature ×3 · Menus & UI ×3 · Bug Fix ×2 · Editor ×2 · Community ×2 · Loot ×1 · Books ×1 · Behind the Scenes ×1**

### 0.1310.0

**Signed books in loot tables keep their words**

Adding a signed book to a chest's loot in the editor now puts that exact book in the chest — its title, author and every page — instead of a blank written book.

- The editor's loot list shows the book's title next to it

**Every editor number works the same way**

Every number you can change in the Train Editor now works the same way: click to raise it, shift-click or right-click to lower it, and Cmd-click (Ctrl-click on Windows and Linux) to type an exact value. That now includes a mob's min and max level, container fill and drop chances, room sizes, exit spacing and more. Rows that had separate − and + buttons are now a single number, and a typed max level or max fill left empty goes back to "all".

- Cmd-click any editor number to type it — including a mob's min and max level
- Right-click lowers a number, the same as shift-click
- Leave a max level or max fill empty to set it back to "all"

**Switch a TV on or off with anything in hand**

Right-click a placed TV to turn it on or off, whatever you're holding — your item isn't used or placed. Sneak to place a block against it instead.

**Bed explosion deaths show a proper death message**

Dying to a bed explosion now shows a real death message on the death screen instead of a raw game id. Fall deaths now read like the chat message too, so you can see how you fell or who knocked you off.

- Bed explosion: "You were killed by [Intentional Game Design]"
- Falls: "You fell from a high place", "You were doomed to fall by Zombie"

**New versions are announced in the Live chat**

When a new version of Dungeon Train comes out, the Live chat now says so: on the website's live page, in the Discord live room, and in Twitch chat while someone is streaming. If you're in game you still see the usual update notice, just once.

**Advancement pop-ups on your Live stream**

Viewers now see your advancement pop-ups even when you stream with chat hidden, and the pop-ups sit on top of your name at the top of the stream instead of under it.

- Pop-ups reach the stream with Stream chat off, Kid mode included
- Pop-ups show over your name on the stream; turn this off with "Pop-ups over your name" on the Stream or Performance tab

# [Twitch integration](https://brennan.games/dungeontrain/update/#v0.1309.0)

![Twitch integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bh679/dungeon-train-mc/main/.github/release-notes/images/twitch-integration.jpg)

Dungeon Train TV can now connect to your Twitch.

Let the stream give your channel a shout-out whenever you hold the Live Eye! You get a shout-out in chat, and your channel is featured in the livestream name and pill for all viewers to see.

Streamers can go one step further. Turn on **Also stream to my channel** and your ride is pushed to your own Twitch channel at the same time, with an optional title and category set for you. Both switches live on the new Account tab, next to Discord, and /twitch unlink takes it all back at any time. Your stream key is never stored.
